description: This file is a configuration include for building and packaging the GCC runtime libraries within a Yocto Project/OpenEmbedded build system. It contains variable assignments, configuration flags, shell functions for configuring, compiling, and installing runtime libraries, as well as package recipe metadata.

methods.name: do_configure
methods.description: Configures the build environment for GCC runtime libraries, including creating dummy libraries and running configure scripts for each target component.

methods.name: do_compile
methods.description: Compiles the configured GCC runtime components, such as libgcc and other target-specific runtime libraries.

methods.name: do_install
methods.description: Installs the compiled runtime libraries and cleans up installation directories.

methods.name: do_check
methods.description: Runs the test suite for the GCC runtime libraries, with specific environment setups.
